sentences.text: If you heat a tank of water over a flame, you have a water heater.
But the heat leaks out through the thin walls, and the water cools.
So you wrap the tank in a thick foam jacket.
But now the foam traps it all, and the water keeps heating.
So you add a thermostat that shuts the flame off at 120 degrees Fahrenheit.
A dip tube carries cold water down, and hot water leaves the top.
And the rod inside is not a heater.
It is an anode rod that rusts instead of the steel tank.
Add a relief valve, a flue and a drain.
Congratulations, you have built a water heater.
